rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for saying that something is connected with or judged in terms of politics.

example.traditional: 呢個決定政治上好敏感。
example.jyutping: nei1 go3 kyut3 ding6 zing3 zi6 soeng6 hou2 man5 gam2

rows.note: Use this more explicit spoken phrasing when you want to say “in the area of politics.”

example.traditional: 喺政治方面，佢仲未夠班。
example.jyutping: hai2 zing3 zi6 fong1 min6 keoi5 zung6 mei6 gau3 baan1
